progress: Complete: 17/17 model decisions and 17/17 actual images reviewed. Nine pass, six pass with notes, two affected-row critical holds. Main owns correction, final validation and publication.
limitations: Independent semantic source QA only. No repeated all-row numeric audit, conversion sweep, engine tests, browser rendering, stock validation, integration or publication.

Berkley exact US/EU SKU and model-code linkage was inspected in official snapshots, not inferred from same pound test. EU selected-variant web reopens failed, so live per-SKU diameter metadata was not independently refreshed.
Maxima duplicate values are source anomalies, not proven errors. Published-source acceptance does not certify measured diameter or hidden product continuity.

The two critical holds are conservative affected-row recommendations for unresolved official photo/table claims. Main may keep unaffected rows as candidates, but must not silently present contradictory images as corroboration.

Pack hashes changed from the initial checkpoint. All four current Berkley candidate rows/editorial were reread and current Group D scoped candidates were reviewed; final hashes and per-model hashes identify the reviewed content.
No candidate packs, assets, shared scripts/data, Git state or releases were modified. Only the two authorized review artifacts were written.
